ai-builder-brain.name: AI-Builder-Brain Universal Intelligence MCP
ai-builder-brain.purpose: Precision BM25 knowledge search, task contracts, DAG planning, and verification barriers
ai-builder-brain.securityImplications: Read-only knowledge access; zero unauthorized file mutation outside scoped project
ai-builder-brain.fallback: Direct local Node.js module import from 04_WORKFLOWS/factory-engine/brain-connector.mjs

astro-docs.name: Astro Documentation MCP
astro-docs.purpose: Authoritative documentation search and schema verification for Astro.js v5+
astro-docs.securityImplications: Read-only access to official documentation cache; zero file system mutation
astro-docs.fallback: Query Master Brain local documentation in 03_SKILLS/astro-architecture-and-seo.md

postgres.name: PostgreSQL MCP Inspector
postgres.purpose: Database schema inspection, query validation, and migration verification
postgres.securityImplications: Scoped read/write to database. Must use restricted role in non-dev environments.
postgres.fallback: Local SQLite fallback or in-memory repository mock

filesystem.name: Scoped Filesystem MCP
filesystem.purpose: Safe, scoped filesystem read/write operations within child project workspace boundary
filesystem.securityImplications: Strictly restricted to ${PROJECT_ROOT}. Master Brain boundary access disallowed.
filesystem.fallback: Native Node.js fs module within project root

fetch.name: Web Content Fetch MCP
fetch.purpose: HTTP web retrieval and documentation/data ingestion for AI agents
fetch.securityImplications: Outbound HTTP requests. Filtered against localhost/private subnet SSRF.

github.name: GitHub Management MCP
github.purpose: Repository metadata, pull request lifecycle, and issue tracking management
github.securityImplications: Access to GitHub API using user token. Must never leak or commit token.

memory.name: Graph Knowledge Memory MCP
memory.purpose: Entity-relation graph memory for persistent agent knowledge across interactions
